votes.motion: Approve the requested variances for 30 Johnson Street (wetland offset from 100 feet to 70 feet; groundwater offset from 5 feet to 4 feet).
votes.quote: the board unanimously approved the requested variances. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 195 Rolling Acres, with the changes to the plan.
votes.quote: on motion by watters and second by jewell, the board voted to approve the variances, with the changes to the plan.

votes.motion: Approve the request for 186 White Street (groundwater offset from 5 feet to 3 feet, per DEP Presby approval).
votes.quote: the board unanimously approved the request.

votes.motion: Approve the request for 61 Upland Avenue (use of a tight tank as the replacement system).
votes.quote: on motion by fortin and second by watters the request was approved.

votes.motion: Grant Elizabeth McColligan an extension to complete repairs at 68 Laurel Lane until January 21, 2022.
votes.quote: an extension to complete repairs was given until january 21, 2022.
the meeting was adjourned at 8:10 pm, all in favor.
